# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** pupil  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, and gloomy face with black eyes. His general appearance suggests he could be a fairly pleasant boy if his sullen exterior were penetrated.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Anthony displays a sullen, disdainful attitude and an impertinent swagger. He is cheeky, cheeky enough to whistle contemptuously or glare shamelessly at his teacher, though he rarely outright defies direct commands. Underneath his defiance, he can be moved to tears when disciplined and vents strong emotion through physical fights.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

## History

Anthony Tulk, an orphaned nephew of Mrs. Timothy Cotton, was taken in by his aunt Mrs. Laurence Tulk and enrolled as a student in Nell Harcourt's school. He quickly distinguished himself by sitting sullenly in the corner and glaring at Nell with enmity. During his time at school, he engaged in misbehavior such as pouring slate bottle water down classmate Aurelia Clay's neck, receiving a lecture on how gentlemen should behave which he dismissed with a contemptuous whistle. He persistently maintained an impertinent swagger and disdainful attitude toward Nell, though she acknowledged he was clever and hoped to win him over. During a particularly tense school day, his defiance briefly broke under punishment from Nell's pointer. When Nell eventually resigned as teacher, Anthony reacted to the distressing news by deliberately picking two unprovoked fights with other boys.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
